source_boundary: Official Eona, Organa, Waypoint, dungeon-system and game-context sources plus independent secondary location guides. Coordinates are owned schematic placements, not copied game pins, not imported map coordinates and not first-hand verified routes.

EONAS_LEGACY.note: Meadow of Beginnings and Dragonrise Basin received a stop-loss source recheck; no VIDEO_VERIFIED or OFFICIAL_VERIFIED individual-location evidence was found.

ORGANA_STATUE.conflict_note: Four public guide-style sources and one trophy-style target source converge on 13 restoration entries; one public map guide reports 14 mapped Statue of Organa layer points without exposing a named 14th restoration entry. The production map publishes the 13 corroborated named entries and retains the 13 vs 14 conflict.

WARP_POINT.naming_policy: Public technical models expose the object name as generic Warp Point, so DragonSwordGuide uses nearest public location or area anchor as the canonical marker suffix.
WARP_POINT.note: Sprint B3 normalizes Warp Points to the 20 public waypoint markers corroborated by map-data-family and public technical-model sources. Exact source coordinates, unlock conditions, costs and cooldowns are not imported or claimed.

DUNGEON.estimated_total: 26 mapped entrances / 30 activity records / 69 broad taxonomy records
DUNGEON.source_independence: COMMON_GAME_DATA_FAMILY_MAP + PUBLIC_TECHNICAL_MODEL + INDEPENDENT_ACTIVITY_DATABASE + INDEPENDENT_QUEST_GUIDE + COMMUNITY_CONTEXT + OFFICIAL_CONTEXT
DUNGEON.note: Sprint B5 reconciles the five held story-style Dungeon entrances and publishes them as world-map Dungeon markers. Dragon Worshipper Hideout is normalized to Dragon Disciple's Hideout where public technical layers use that canonical name; it remains searchable as an alias. Difficulty variants, internal bosses, raid-only encounters and reward variants are not separate map markers.

BOSS.note: Sprint B4 publishes open-world Field Boss map markers only. Dungeon, raid and internal boss encounters are not published as world-map markers, and dynamic mechanics are not claimed.
